notes.title: ARCHANGEL ANNOUNCEMENTS MARCH 2019
notes.content:
This is the Archangel Announcements post for March! Here we will discuss the features for the next major public update for the month! 

Most of these features are already present in the latest iteration of our experimental preview build! Check out [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/682450/discussions/0/3104564981106354471/]this thread[/url] to see how you can get in on the action!
_________________________________________________

[h1][b]New Feature : Soft Lock[/b][/h1]

A new function called 'Soft Lock' has been completed in preparation of the coming single-player mission modes. It was meant to address issues with the default game camera and lock-on system's limitations when fighting multiple opponents. For the purposes of the game, the old system will be called 'Hard Lock' and this new system will be called 'Soft Lock' as they both exist as different targeting modes.

Soft Lock allows the player to utilize the right directional stick or mouse to move the camera while maintaining a lock on a target. This allows the player to freely scan their surroundings while launching their attacks on a chosen target. In addition, they can simply change targets by 'looking' at another unit and positioning said unit near the center of their screen, providing an alternative to the automatic target transfer toggle in the older system. This gives players more freedom to look around and gain awareness of their surroundings.

However, using the soft lock target system has a price. It loses two functions exclusive to hard lock mode : The state indicators, which tell you if the enemy is in a guarded state or invincible to further attack, and the predictive arrow system, that shows you the movement direction and roughly predicts the target's future position. Also, though Hard Lock does not allow the player to freely move the camera around, it 'locks' the target to the center of the player's screen at all times - a very important tool against more difficult mobile enemies.

The trick to using these target systems rely on switching between them according to one's convenience. For now they have two different button assignments, with the Soft-lock being  D.pad Down / V in the preview build. This may be subject to change. In the future we may reduce both modes into a singular lock-on button, which cycles between these modes.

[h1][b]New Feature : Cruise Flight[/b][/h1]

With the larger maps that will be utilized in single-player campaigns, Archangels will be expected to cross longer distances. Some Archangels built with the low speed stat will have some obvious problems handling missions that require a lot of travel. Luckily, the standard Imperial Archangel is equipped with a 'Cruise Flight' mode that allows them to enter high-speed, sustained flight, without expending as much boost resources and going into overload. This feature is not normally used by Commercial builds for the Arena, but is a convenience heavily utilized by many paramilitary units.

It should be noted that in this flight mode, boost and stability will be reduced to a minimum as the Archangel generator's resources will be redirected into sustaining the flight mode. This means that an Archangel is actually vulnerable to damage and overload in this mode, and should avoid rushing headlong into battle with this function. In addition, going into Cruise Flight requires a long and loud charging period before startup, and that makes it difficult to use in a heated battle.

Cruise Flight currently has its own default button assignment (D. Pad Up / R) in the preview build. This may be subject to change.

[h1][b]New Feature : Radar[/b][/h1]

This one is a bit self-explanatory; A simple radar has been added to the HUD, which only appears in certain game modes such as Horde and the upcoming missions for solo play. This provides an additional display to help with the player's positional awareness of multiple enemies (and allies).

[h1][b]New Feature : Dramatic Dodge[/b][/h1]

A mix of cosmetic flair and actual game mechanics, the game will go into slow motion if an Archangel perfectly times a dodge or an invincibility frame maneuver to avoid an attack. This allows the dodging player time to plan their next moves or counterattack. However, beware that this respite also allows the attacker to dodge cancel or prepare their own followup maneuvers. This feature was made to add more visual flair to melee combat, also adding to the overall aesthetic ('roman') of the game's battle systems.

[h1][b]New Weapon : Vajra Cannon[/b][/h1]

The Vajra Cannon is an Astra-made handheld plasma cannon that creates super-heated orb-shaped clouds on impact. The orbs linger and deal tick-based damage, making them useful as area-denial weapons, attack deterrents, and stun-lock tools. If fired at close range, the projectile fails to synthesize and merely behaves as a high-stability damage projectile. With a weight of 1250, the Vajra carries 3 shots by default. Its secondary ability is a reload, making it similar to other guns (Ranger, Emancipator) that share its weight value. 

We hope this weapon adds a new dimension to the ranged equipment options for the game!

[h1][b]Major Game Mechanics and Balancing[/b][/h1]

This one is quite lengthy and we suggest looking up the coming patch notes for the balance changes regarding the different weapons. (If you want to see them now, we suggest looking at the preview build thread to see what has changed) We will discuss the most significant changes in their own sections below.

[h1][b]System Update : Boost and Overload[/b][/h1]

The Overload System used to be a 4 second timer that counted down regardless of the state of the player, with the exception of the down state which allowed them to instantly restore both stability and boost. This system allowed for gameplay that effectively bypassed the 'down period' of the timer, allowing certain builds with long-winded attacks to not suffer the penalties of going into overload. For this reason, Overload is now a conditional 4 second timer; It pauses whenever players take actions that aren't simply walking/moving around, standing still, falling, or taking damage. This means that if a player would relentlessly attack or do maneuvers, it is quite possible for them to stay stuck in overload. 

By doing this, we made overload more punishing (as it was meant to be) and make it so players would think twice about carelessly expending boost. To compensate for this change, we've reduced the base cost for dodging, effectively giving archangels across the board more resources to avoid going into overload.

[h1][b]Weapon Rework : Liberator Missile Launcher[/b][/h1]

The Liberator Missile Launcher's gameplay has been changed, or more specifically, its primary and alt-fire have been switched. The primary fire of the Liberator will now rapidly fire homing missiles at the target, while its alternate fire launches a non-homing, but powerful trio of missiles. Also, the Liberator's ammo refresh rate has been largely increased, allowing players to have more missiles on hand more often.

[h1][b]Weapon Weight Changes and Buffs : Schafer and Wespe [/b][/h1]

The Schafer Flamethrower and Wespe Assault Rifle are unique hand weapons in that their primary fire deals 0 stab damage. Due to stability now playing a major role compared to older iterations of the game, these weapons have become less desirable due to their inherent weakness. Rather than change their gameplay design, we've decided to reduce their weight to 1000, making them budget ranged weapon options. They've also received a damage buff, making them more threatening at whittling down enemy HP.


[h1][b]DEVELOPMENT CONTINUES[/b][/h1]

We'd like to thank everyone who has supported the game thus far as we continue development through the first quarter of 2019. Don't fret, there's much more to come!


_________________________________________________

As usual, make sure to like/follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/Garrison.Archangel/]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/Play_Archangel]Twitter[/url] for news and updates! 
We also have a [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCfpgJywWI0duZUAaeffOLLA]YouTube[/url] channel where we post videos of our game's development. 
You can also visit our [url=https://discord.gg/DD4QaqV ]Discord[/url] and talk with the devs and players of the game!

notes.title: FEBRUARY PRE-BALANCE PATCH - UPDATE 0.18.5
notes.content:
Thanks for joining us in 2019. Here are the new internal system updates before we move into balance patches at the end of February.


[h1][b]Movement System Updates[/b][/h1]

With the update to the boost system and with the various mobility options now present in the game, we've upped the multiplier modifier for backward and sideward movement, which had been previously clamped at 50% and 75% respectively. They now both operate at 80% of forward movement speed, giving a higher overall sense of mobility for all.

In addition, held weapons such as machineguns, missiles and other rapid fire weapons, now disable gravity while in use. The exception to this rule are shields. While held, these rapid weapons do not allow for boost regeneration. Shields on the other hand, allow for both stability and boost regeneration.

[h1][b]Boost System (Experimental): Flight Mode[/b][/h1]

We introduced a new boost movement system while unlocked, called Flight Mode. It has a bit of startup, and quickly drains boost and stability, but allows the player to move forward at a sustained high speed. It immediately ends as soon as you lock on to a target.

This feature was made for long distance travelling in preparation for the upcoming missions over large maps.

[h1][b]Visual Updates[/b][/h1]

There are several visual updates, from animation layering for held weapons like firearms and shields, to UI updates with trackers for multiple enemy, allied and objective targets. We also made melee weapon trails a bit more flashy to approach the rule of cool anime look we set out to do. 

In addition, new camera and graphic settings are available for players who want a different look at the game. Try out the over-the-shoulder camera setting in the gameplay options!


[h1][b]AI and Horde updates[/b][/h1]

The AI has been tweaked in preparation for the coming mission modes, and some of these changes can already be seen in horde mode and the existing AI combatants in the various game modes (arcade, custom game, etc).

Though these changes are minor, there's quite a bit of them. We suggest playing the AI yourselves to feel the changes for yourself.

[h1][b]Engine Updates[/b][/h1]

Garrison: Archangel runs in Unity, and much of the development in January was spent porting and updating new features to Unity 2018.3. For this reason, we also addressed many bugs and refactored many existing systems. Since each individual change is minor, it is best to refer to the detailed list below.



[h1][b]Changelog List[/b][/h1]

Includes changes from v0.18.0 up to v0.18.5

[b]New Mechanics and Features[/b]
- New Movement: Flight Boost - Increased Boost speed used for traversal when no targets are locked. Does not overload Boost meter, but the stronger acceleration drains Stability. Forward movement only, no vertical or side movement.
- New settings : Added new SHOULDER camera offset in Gameplay Options.
- New Alternates/Cosmetics: Weapon skins for RANGER, WESPE, MOLNIYA, DRAGOON, EMANCIPATOR, UHLAN,  TATZELWURM, POPIGAI and YULONG

[b]Gameplay Changes[/b]
- Sideward movement speed while boosting increased to 80% from 75%.
- Backward movement speed while boosting increased to 80% from 50%.
- Input buffer now allows repeat inputs to extend the timer, and uses the last input when triggering. This does not prevent late single inputs from expiring.
- Camera offsets now adjust to make tilting upwards more comfortable.
- Adjusted AI parameters to lessen random jumping.
- Horde Grunt enemies now have reduced mobility.
- Held Attacks now also disable Gravity. Affected weapons include Autoguns, Missiles, Cannons.
- Reduced Flinch Cancel input restriction from 6 frames to 2 frames.
- Animation layering for gun aiming and recoil.
- Increased AI priority for Dodge Cancel movement.
- Flight Boost will now not automatically cancel when re-locking into a target in far distances.
- Updated Horde mode Pickups for Health and Boost.


[b]Updated Features[/b]

notes.title: ARCHANGEL ANNOUNCEMENTS JANUARY 2019
notes.content:
Welcome to the first Archangel Announcements of 2019! Thank you to all our players who've supported us on Steam since 2018, and especially to everyone who's stuck with us for longer than that!

Without any further ado, here we go!
_________________________________________________

[h1][b]Upcoming Feature : Mission Generator[/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31962666/43e1787fdf07f69cc255d31c40ed103483a4bdd9.png[/img]

One of our primary goals this 2019 is the completion of the Single-player Campaign we discussed in previous announcements and media. In this game mode, the player takes the role of a mercenary on the war-torn planet of Baja Secunda. Various factions and corporations have taken an interest in the conflict, and pursue their agenda in the many battlefields.

Central to that single-player campaign is a procedural mission generation system. Each 'turn', the different factions post missions, from among which the player can choose. Such missions can vary in objective and scope, from sabotage, assassination, VIP defense, area control, target tests and much more. 

After then, it is up to the player's skill, archangel and luck to complete these missions.

Successful completion of these missions provides the player with monetary rewards and faction rating. Faction rating represents the value, respect and/or rank the mercenary has achieved within a faction. It unlocks several benefits, such as parts, weapons, upgrades and cosmetics unique to each faction or corporation. 

But beware; Every mission affects another faction negatively. Clients will always have rivals and enemies who will remember your actions. Hostile actions against such factions will lower your faction rating with them. A low enough faction rating might mean a ban from acquiring certain goods. Unlucky players may even be attacked by that faction's armed forces while in the middle of another mission!

The mission generator represents the basic game 'flow' of the planned campaign, and we aim to release it for public testing by next month. It will have the mission generation system, the faction rating system, and even the faction threat system. We hope players enjoy this preview of what's to come.

Shops, upgrades, unlocks, narrative content and the other progression systems described above will follow. We will make sure to update everyone and discuss them in future statements.


[h1][b]Visual Updates : HUD and Animation[/b][/h1]

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/RigidKindAntelopegroundsquirrel-size_restricted.gif[/img]

Some animation updates can be expected in the following weeks. They particularly involve held weapons and shields, to make them feel more organic. We applied an animation layering system we currently use for our idle walking and moving animations, differentiating flight from grounded movement as well as varying movement speeds.

With the development of the single-player mode, we're also adding new elements to the HUD, such as ally and enemy indicator pips for combatants not in your lock-on reticule. This will help players differentiate allies and enemies with one glance during messy skirmishes.

Another minor addition to the HUD is a lead pip, which basically predicts the position and movement direction of the locked-on target. This was mostly a debug feature for us to test our projectiles' tracking and predictive capabilities, but it may assist players who appreciate additional information! (Also it looks cool and adds to the immersion, according to Paolore.)

We hope these visual changes prepare players for the challenges of the new game mode, since multiple enemies and allies will be more common.


[h1][b]New Preset : Uusha Jajanka[/b][/h1]

The winner of the Cosmic Clash Season 2 Finale, Uusha Jajanka, has been added to the roster. 

It is the first competitive build to win after the massive mechanics overhaul on stability and boost - this monster boasts very high armor, stability and deflection, and obliterates the competition with its Dominus and Dragoon!


[h1][b]Community Contest Policy Update : Character Roster and Ghosts[/b][/h1]

Ever since 2017, we've worked closely with our community and have added many of our player's creations to the game. After 2 years of development, our Character Roster has grown to a whopping 32 Archangels, with more than half of them (17) being champions and contest winners!

Sadly, due to this large number, we've decided to limit community contest additions to the roster from now on. This change will particularly affect our recurring tournaments, such as Cosmic Clash. We will still have specific tournaments that feature roster addition as a prize, but only if we explicitly state it as part of the rewards.

However, do not fret! Due to the developments toward the single-player content, we've actually opened new avenues for community submission content. The one we'll discuss here are the [i]Ghosts[/i].

Ghosts are Archangels that cannot be selected by players in Custom Game. They will only appear randomly in the single-player campaign missions and horde mode.

The Characters represent well-known Archangel pilots in the Archangel Tournament League (ATL), the immensely popular arena sport throughout the Solar Empire. They are basically sport celebrities. The arcade mode of the game represents the player fighting their way up through the ATL. With the exception of horde mode, everything we've shown so far in the game is the perspective of the Archangel Athlete fighting for glory in the Arena.

However, the ATL with all its rules and safety regulations, do not represent the true military capabilities of the Archangel. It is, first and foremost, a weapon of war - which is what the campaign mode will focus on. Therefore, Ghosts are the pilots you find on the battlefield. Most of them don't have a name to give you, and frankly, couldn't care less. They're most likely mercenaries, just like you, or faction agents who simply need to complete a mission.

The Ghost system allows us to hold grunt and faction officer creation contests, which is one of the community activities requested of us. We also found that a lot of narrative suggestions from our community collaborators could be better put in the context of the battlefield rather than the arena. This means that we may move around existing characters to become ghosts or have characters who also appear in the single-player campaign.



[h1][b]Community Contest : DEADLY DUETS[/b][/h1]

The first community contest is made by our longtime supporter, Robofights! Watch the video [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1mVjaut1zaw]here[/url]!

notes.title: Happy Holidays! Garrison: Archangel Public Update v0.17.2
notes.content:
Happy Holidays from the Garrison: Archangel staff! This is the December 2018 Public Update to Garrison: Archangel.

[h1][b]Stability System Rework[/b][/h1]

The stability system has been reworked to become a more straightforward stat. The value presented on the stability stat now purely refers to the amount of stability damage one can take before flinching, a state now formally called 'Vulnerability'. 

This means archangels with higher stability can resist more damage before being stunned or flinched, regardless of their load values.


[h1][b]New System : Vulnerability[/b][/h1]

Vulnerability is a state in which an Archangel becomes susceptible to getting stunned or flinching from attacks that deal at least one point of stability damage. After a certain amount of stability damage is dealt during this state, Archangels are destabilized. 

This state is represented by the red portion of the stability bar on the HUD. Its value (the amount of stability damage one can take in this state before being destabilized) is modified by an Archangel's load percentage.

During this state, Archangels also suffer from a penalty to dodge cancel, which are called vulnerable dodge cancels. Archangels in this state also lose their passive deflection bonuses until they regain at least one stability point.


[h1][b]Boost System Rework[/b][/h1]

The boost system has also been overhauled. 

First, All types of Dodging now cause a longer pause before boost can be regenerated. Boosting and Flight no longer have this pause. 

Second, Dodge now has three formal types: 
Normal Dodge - which is dodging while neutral (not in the middle of any animation).
Dodge Cancel - which is dodging while in the middle of an animation and not in the vulnerable state.  This costs 1.5x the normal dodge costs.
Vulnerable Dodge Cancel (V.Dodge Cancel) - which is any dodge cancel performed during the vulnerable state. This costs 3x the normal dodge costs.

Third, a new stat called 'Boost Regeneration' has been introduced and shown in the garage stat list. It determines how fast an Archangel regains Boost. It is linked to the Speed Stat. 


[h1][b]New Weapon : Star Gauntlet[/b][/h1]

The Archangel Arms Concept Competition 2018 winner finally makes its public debut! This giant fist offers a wide variety of different attacks with different movements and options! It's secondary ability is 'Charge' - which allows it to power up its forward melee attack, transforming it into different attacks depending on the charge level!

Check it out!


[h1][b]New Maps[/b][/h1]

Two new maps, Riocorte Dam and the Solar Farm have been added. These are maps planned to be used for single-player campaigns that take place on the planet Baja Secunda, and are thus works in progress! Please expect more updates for them soon!

notes.title: ARCHANGEL ANNOUNCEMENTS NOVEMBER 2018
notes.content:
Welcome to our sixth and belated issue of Archangel Announcements.

_________________________________________________

[h1][b]New Feature : Updated Combat GUI[/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31962666/ce13a4ba91b511318ef5f5e5f8aeb61c7b61e0a7.png[/img]

The Combat UI has been updated for the first time since the early demo. This UI update also comes as a preparation for the single-player content and missions we have planned. Our aim was to create a cleaner overall look and address several issues with the older UI.

The weapons have now been arranged in a diamond, with the top being the shoulder weapon, the left and right being the hands, and the bottom being the back weapon. 

We now utilize divisions of 500 for HP bars, and always make the numerical value of HP visible. At the same time we did away with the disappearing boost bar and gave boost and stability permanent space and visibility.

The bars also change in length depending on the value of the portrayed stat, which also gives players a better gauge of their own strengths. The target's HP bar also has this treatment.

You can see this new GUI (or at least parts of it) in the preview version of the game. We hope it provides a better experience in the public release of this update!


[h1][b]New Feature : Barriers and Burning Status Effects[/b][/h1]

As our game mechanics change and new weapons are added, new systems begin to come into play. In the latest public update, we will be adding the Burning and Barrier States to the game. 

Certain weapons will impose the Burning on targets, such as the Schafer flamethrower, and the Yulong and Tiangou Swarm Missiles. Meanwhile, the Barrier State will be generated by November's new weapon, the Agimat Barrier.

[i]Burning[/i] is a damage over time state that deals 25 damage per second for the duration of its effect. Its 'stacks' come in the form of additional time, which extend its duration to a maximum of 10 seconds. 

Each combatant only possesses a single 'stack' of burning; so burning afflictions from different sources only add to a singular total duration of an Archangel's burning state.

[i]Barrier[/i] grants a unit temporary armor and stability for a short period, allowing them to ignore damage that would otherwise flinch or destabilize them, as well as reducing damage to armor. 

However, a barrier can only receive a set amount of armor and stability damage before it breaks.

 For now, only the Agimat Barrier can generate this effect, and the actual numbers are indicated below.


[h1][b] Weapon Balance and Mechanics Overhaul[/b][/h1]

November was originally supposed to be our final balance pass month before our full release in the original road map, and though a lot of plans have changed and deviated, we've decided to pull off a lot of dramatic changes to existing weaponry and systems.

Due to the sheer number of stats and weapons impacted, we will save the complete changelog for the update this friday, November 30th. 

Those in the preview build have had a taste of these changes, which are also detailed here : https://steamcommunity.com/app/682450/discussions/0/3104564981106354471/

The most impacted equipment are those whose gameplay mechanics have changed dramatically. They have their own sections below.


[h1][b]Modified Weapon : SCHAFER FLAMETHROWER[/b][/h1]

Schafer now deals 0 stability damage, but now inflicts the 'Burning' status effect on all those hit by its attacks. The schafer is now centered around dealing armor damage over time with the burning status effect and its high rate of fire.

It loses its reload on demand secondary move in favor of a cooldown based reload similar to the peacemaker that triggers only when ammo count reaches zero and is left alone to reload.

 To make up for this, its special now lobs a new napalm projectile that consumes 12 counts of ammunition, but applies a full stack of burning on all units caught in its explosion


[h1][b]Modified Weapon : GRAM RAILGUN[/b][/h1]

The Gram Railgun loses its old long startup in favor of chargeable damage. Tapping the Gram Railgun quickly fires off an instantaneous 150/150 hitscan projectile, but holding it for a longer period allows it to deal more damage, going up to 1500/1500 damage.

The railgun can be flinched, destabilized or cancelled out of its charge state, which gives players several options to utilize when fielding and fighting against it.


[h1][b]New Shoulder Equipment : AGIMAT BARRIER[/b][/h1]

The new weapon for November is the Agimat Barrier system, mounted on the shoulder. 

A secret weapon developed during the Demiurge Incursion wars, it has been declassified by the Solar Empire and Maaga Industries for public purchase. It has made its way to the arena, and to a handful of pilots.

The Agimat system creates a barrier on activation that can absorb up to 1000 stability or armor damage, an effect that lasts for 5 seconds. If it takes 1000 or more damage of either type before then, it ends prematurely, leaving the Archangel open to attack.

The barriers take 15 seconds to recharge between activations.



[h1][b]AACC2018 Winner Equipment Release : ZIQINILE PELERINA[/b][/h1]

The winner of the Archangel Arms Concept Competition 2018's Rearmed and Refitted Category is the shoulder cape 'Ziqinile Pelerina', which has the same mechanics and stats as the Obolochka shoulder shields. 


It is the only weapon in game that currently uses cloth physics for movement and aesthetics. Due to this, visual bugs will sadly be very common - as the game wasn't made with cloth physics in mind. 

But... the people have spoken (and quite strongly, we might add!) and we must oblige.

If you want to add a fancy touch to your Archangel, try it out in the coming update or switch over to our experimental preview build!



[h1][b]AACC2018 Winner Equipment Preview : STAR GAUNTLET[/b][/h1]

Although it is not yet going to be part of our coming update this friday, we have shown progress on the 'Star Gauntlet' - the AACC2018 winner of the Cutting Edge category. It features an all new movelist 
and mechanic.

You can watch this [url=https://youtu.be/a0XhTnR-DUI?t=549]Wednesday Warzone episode[/url] to see it in action, and Paolore even shows off the moves and systems.

This weapon will be released in December!



[h1][b]New Presets : Spooktober Skirmish, ESGS Epic and Cosmic Clash Winners[/b][/h1]

Several contests passed us by last month, and several champions have been added to our hall of fame. These winning units have been added to the permanent roster as a result :

* Spooktober Skirmish Winner : HIMASHO KURARA
* ESGS Epic 2018 Winner : LEEK SLICER
* Cosmic Clash S02E03 Winner : ARCHEOPTERYX
* Cosmic Clash S02E04 Winner : UUSHA IL KARMA

You'll see their devious designs soon! (Or if you're in our preview build, you've probably seen them already!)



[h1][b]DEVELOPMENT CONTINUES[/b][/h1]

As always, especially with the dramatic November update, we still continue to improve existing game systems and mechanics, as well as fix bugs reported by our community. Please do join our Discord channel and our social media pages so you can work with us in developing Garrison: Archangel to be the definitive custom mecha game for PC.

As usual, make sure to like/follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/Garrison.Archangel/]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/Play_Archangel]Twitter[/url] for news and updates!

You can also visit our [url=https://discord.gg/DD4QaqV ]Discord[/url] and talk with the devs and players of the game!

notes.title: ARCHANGEL ANNOUNCEMENTS OCTOBER 2018

Welcome to our fifth issue of Archangel Announcements.

[h1][b]New Feature : Centralized Chat System (and Worldwide Filter changes)[/b][/h1]

We decided to add a new feature we're testing out in the preview builds at the moment, called a centralized chat box you can access in the upper left field of the game. 

The purpose for this centralized chatbox is to track other players currently in the game and to more easily arrange for multiplayer games without relying on external applications like Discord. 

In addition to this, we set the multiplayer's default filters to worldwide so that all players can find any lobby set up across the world. We hope more of our players find each other and play more games.

We intend to update the public build by October 19, Friday, to include this new feature (as well as other bug fixes and mechanics updates).

notes.title: ARCHANGEL ANNOUNCEMENTS SEPTEMBER 2018
notes.content:
Welcome to our fourth issue of Archangel Announcements.

_________________________________________________

[h1][b]Single Player Campaign Development - Warmachines[/b][/h1]

As revealed in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/682450/announcements/detail/1688174556429067639]previous issue[/url] of Archangel Announcements, we've opted to create a single-player campaign where you take the role of a mercenary doing various dirty jobs for the different factions on a wartorn planet. Our [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ve4PHRVBAT0]previous episode[/url] of Wednesday Warzone revealed this planet's name to be "Baja Secunda".

Baja Secunda is a planet known for its wide swathes of arid wasteland, though it wasn't always this way; it was once a 'paradise planet' akin to an untouched Earth. This all changed during the Incursion Wars with the Demiurge : Massive weapons of mass destruction were fielded and destroyed much of the planet's ecology. Much of the planet was reduced to an arid wasteland, and the few places that can still sustain human habitation currently suffer from rapid desertification.

Despite this, Baja Secunda is the site of a growing conflict between two powerful 'Imperial Prefectures' and their many allies. There is also a rising anti-Imperial sentiment among the populace of Baja Secunda, and it has led to a separatist revolt in this time of instability. Now, there is a high demand for mercenaries... and weapons.

Along with the Archangels our players know about, here are just some samples of the warmachines you may see (and fight) in the single-player campaign.

Tanks!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DfqYDKS.png[/img]

Helicopters!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/g4FsNC3.png[/img]

Planes!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/abzt4ne.png[/img]

And here is the 'grandaddy' of the Archangels, the Angel 'Powersuit' units that the Solar Empire fielded during its infancy. Archangels were developed from overengineering the original designs, and became so large that they could no longer be called 'powersuits'. These Angel powersuits, though less powerful and lightly armored, are still commonly fielded by various paramilitary groups.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5tZPaN8.png[/img]


These different enemy types may also be added to the existing horde mode, replacing earlier levels of Archangels. More to follow as development continues!



[h1][b]New Weapon Coming : The Peacemaker[/b][/h1]
 
Rather than two new weapons, we'll only be releasing one weapon at the end of the month, called the 'Peacemaker'. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/VDFbf0I.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wqM5T7x.png[/img]

It is a pistol manufactured by Eagle Enterprises, and will be the first 500 weight hand gun weapon in the game.

It will be released to the public on the fourth week of September, and possibly earlier on the preview branch.



[h1][b]CONTEST : ARCHANGEL ARMS CONCEPT CONTEST 2018[/b][/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/F2uqpws.png[/img]

Want to add a new weapon to the world of Garrison: Archangel? Win this contest and we'll work with you to make it! You can even win a free steam key and add to the lore of the universe!

Rules and more contest details[b] [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf_YqBLiQ3H-SQRDd8kxFLmcZKhuw3dS8dZ7blTcQieWZb_yQ/viewform?usp=sf_link]HERE[/url][/b]. ( goo. gl/forms/4kTW1ZzRhrkOZF9D3 )

The contest is open to everyone, and it does not require a purchase of the game! Entries will be open until September 26, 2018 only!





[h1][b]General Bug Fixing and Game Mechanics Development Continues[/b][/h1]

As always, our discord and steam page is open to receive comments and bug reports. Bug fixes and small mechanics updates come frequently through the preview branch, and go into public once issues have been stabilized.

You can learn how to opt into the preview branch [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/682450/discussions/0/1728701877510143107/]here[/url].


More rules and details will follow soon! Stay tuned for announcements in our various social media!

notes.title: ARCHANGEL ANNOUNCEMENTS AUGUST 2018
notes.content:
Welcome to our belated third issue of Archangel Announcements.

_________________________________________________

[h1][b]Major Graphics and Game System Update[/b][/h1]

If you have been following our preview builds and previous announcements, as well as our Wednesday Warzones, you should be aware of the major game mechanics and physics overhaul that came out with the latest update.  This update also affects network play, and fixes some issues present in previous iterations of the netcode.

On top of this major system change, we've also upgraded the graphics of the game, changing up hitsparks, thruster flares, adding postprocessing and bloom, as well as other graphic tweaks.

As a result, the game looks and feels a lot different from before, and hopefully, for the better! 

There are so many changes from the previous iteration of the public build (0.14) that we literally have a thread [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/682450/discussions/0/1728701877515011013/]here[/url] dedicated to the collected changelogs. If you are coming in from 0.14 and haven't played any of the preview builds, we suggest you see these changes for yourself in the latest update (0.15)

Try it out and tell us what you think!


[h1][b]Single Player Campaign Development - Upgrades and Concepts[/b][/h1]

As discussed in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/682450/announcements/detail/1681414719787101465]previous issue[/url] of Archangel Announcements, we've opted to create a single-player campaign where you take the role of a mercenary doing various dirty jobs for the different factions on a wartorn planet. 

Depending on the missions you take and the enemies you make, you will gain access to parts, weapons and other rewards. 

We've allowed the players to gain access to certain weapons and bodies by entering a code/cheat as discussed in the update announcement here. These represent rewards from specific factions.

But what players have yet to see are 'upgraded' forms of the existing parts, which you can unlock by doing missions, and using the currency gained to enhance the 'basic' versions of such equipment.

For example, here is an upgraded Lynx :

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DHfBsUY.png[/img]

The entirety of the planned single-player campaign takes place on a desert planet called Baja Secunda, where several factions fight for control of various resources and territories, such as solar farms. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yP1OUwn.jpg[/img]

All of what is presented thus far is a work in progress. More will be revealed as development continues. Please look forward to more in the future.



[h1][b]New Parts Coming : Asymmetric Shoulder Shield and Jump Jets[/b][/h1]

Staying true to the pattern of updates thus far, we are releasing two new parts at the end of this month.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0adbo8j.png[/img]

The first is a Medvedev-made Asymmetric Shield mounted on the shoulder, which gives the capabilities of a held shield without requiring a free hand.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2nxoe7u.png[/img]

The second are shoulder-mounted jumpjets made by Stahlwalder, that provide a boost to upward movement and provide a free jump maneuver with a 3 second cooldown.

They will be released to the public on the fourth week of August.



[h1][b]Fashion Fight Winner Cosmetic Revealed![/b][/h1]

Anubis, the winner of the Fashion Fight competition held a few months ago, will soon be outfitted by a special alternate Halo Shield in a future update (4th week of august update). This design was made through the cooperation of the G:A Dev Team, and the creator of the Anubis submission - SeijiTataki.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/POx8FGb.png[/img]

The cosmetic will simply be called the 'Anubis Shield', and will also be made available for all players.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/AP1meN5.png[/img]

More fashion options for everyone!



[h1][b]CONTEST : ARCHANGEL ARMS CONCEPT CONTEST 2018[/b][/h1]

As promised by Paolore in previous announcements, we will be having a weapon design contest that will begin on the last week of August.

It will be open to all players and interested parties. You can create your own Archangel weaponry and join for a chance to have it added to the game. 

Two winners can receive Steam Keys and in-game/lore credit (Alternatively, you may make your own lore to explain the weapon's origins!)


[b]Categories :[/b]

- Rearmed and Refitted - Create your own design of an existing weapon in the game. Have your own idea for a large railgun sword, like the Dominus? Show us your designs!

- The Cutting Edge - For aspiring weapons engineers who think they have a weapon idea that will revolutionize warfare in the Garrison: Archangel universe. Sky's the limit!



More rules and details will follow soon! Stay tuned for announcements in our various social media!



_________________________________________________


There's been a lot of ups and downs the past month, but development continues! Help us make this game the customizable mecha fighting game of our dreams!

notes.title: ARCHANGEL ANNOUNCEMENTS JULY 2018
notes.content:
Welcome to our second issue of Archangel Announcements.

_________________________________________________

[h1][b]New Update Direction : Preview Opt-in[/b][/h1]

We have decided to change the way in which we release updates for the game. Thus far, we had been updating the publicly accessible game weekly, though several major updates we had released suffered from severe bugs and problems that we regretfully had missed or overlooked. 

We are a small indie company, and admittedly, we do not have the resources to continue operating with weekly updates like before without running into such issues. 

This is why, we have decided to space out our public release updates, without strictly adhering to weekly schedules. This way we can ensure that only our most recent stable build will always be what is publicly accessible.

However, to go with this change, we intend to make a 'preview' version of the game which we will update very frequently (potentially nightly), representing our very latest (and most likely buggy) version of the game. Players may opt into playing this version of G:A and see the latest progress of the game's development if they do not mind dealing with bugs.

We will create a thread in the game's Discussion Forum to track these Preview Updates, as opposed to the announcements we make for Public Release Updates. 

More details and instructions on how to opt in to this new system will follow. Stay tuned to our social media and our discussion forums this friday. (07/06/18)



[h1][b]Major Netcode Development Continues[/b][/h1]

Last month, we discussed our major rework of the game's physics framework to better improve our netcode. We are still in the process of fixing this issue. We aim to fully complete the transition by the end of the month. 

We may start testing the new physics and netcode via our preview updates (as explained above) by the second week of July.



[h1][b]Visual Updates and Optimization[/b][/h1]

We will be updating the visuals for the game, following optimization of its graphics for lower end machines. These updates will include changes to the in-game UI, lighting, hitsparks and projectile particles and trails.

Our Wednesday Warzones will serve as a visual preview of our planned changes going forward, so make sure to subscribe to our youtube channel (links below!) We may also start integrating them in our preview updates, as mentioned above.



[h1][b]Second Bi-monthly Balance[/b][/h1]

July will be our second month for balancing. We have had several new weapons and parts come out from the previous two months, and several "OP" equipment have come to light. Some older weapons may also need updating as a result of the new balance changes and available equipment pool.

We intend to release the balance changes in the update of 07/13/18.



[h1][b]New Single-Player Focus![/b][/h1]

We have officially shifted our focus from fully online multiplayer and progression to making a fully realized single-player experience. 

This does not mean we have abandoned our initial plans for a fully-formed multiplayer experience with online stores, leaderboards and progression, only that it will be moved down the development line in favor of our new direction.

Neither does this mean that we will give up our core arena multiplayer game modes. We will continue to balance around PVP and update content for our existing couch and online play.

Now, for the campaign's details!

We intend to make a single-player campaign in which you play as a mercenary accepting missions and upgrading your equipment by buying upgrades and new parts. 

As you progress, certain factions will either become your friends... or your enemies. It all depends on the missions you choose to fulfill... and who you decide to fight.

More details on this will follow! Stay tuned to our social media updates and Wednesday Warzones to come!



[h1][b]New Parts Coming![/b][/h1]

Staying true to the pattern of updates thus far, we are releasing some new parts at the end of this month.

We aim to add two new shoulder weapons at the end of this month.

One of them will be from a never before seen manufacturer, "Bleeding Edge Designs"!



[h1][b]Fashion Fight Winners, New Presets and Updates![/b][/h1]

Congratulations to our fashion fight winners, Anubis, Bad Cop, and the Type 89 A8M "Ripzaku"! They will be added as presets in the game and to the canon of the lore! 

As per our last update, we had also added two new presets, Rude Boi and SSS.Crimsontrigger, made by members of the Dev Team!

On top of this, we revisited some of our older presets and updated them with our newer weapons. We hope they give everyone a more unique challenge this time around!

_________________________________________________


We hope you stick through with us as we continue development of this game, so we can make it the mecha game of our dreams!


As usual, make sure to like/follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/Garrison.Archangel/]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/Play_Archangel]Twitter[/url] for news and updates!

notes.title: ARCHANGEL ANNOUNCEMENTS JUNE 2018
notes.content:
After receiving feedback from our community here at Steam, we've decided to do a monthly newsletter (via Announcements) regarding our plans, feedback and just general heads-up of our development direction at the beginning of each month.

Basically, this is a monthly text version of our Wednesday Warzone, which allows for a little more organization (and editing!) in our information dissemination.

So... this is our first issue! Let's down to business!

_________________________________________________

[h1][b]Major Netcode Development and changes to the Roadmap[/b][/h1]

Netcode and multiplayer are a major area of concern for us, and we have been continually fixing and updating it to make it a smoother and better experience for everyone. However, we reached a point where its development hit a roadblock. 

To overcome this challenge, we would need to overhaul a core framework of the game, which we estimate will take a month to complete. It is quite the heavy update that will affect many systems in the game (even combat in offline/singleplayer game modes) and thus we have to change up development schedules to prioritize this.

Obviously, this would impact the roadmap laid out in our previous [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/682450/announcements/detail/1649881910387494728]announcement[/url], especially since we intended on completing development on dedicated server applications and implementing dedicated servers at the end of this month. This will also potentially impact future plans, possibly moving them back by a month or changing them entirely (particularly online services).

Completing this development will lead to improvements in the netcode and online play we previously could not achieve. This will improve our current system of peer-to-peer online matches, as well as future dedicated server-based multiplayer systems.

But do not fret, for we will continue to have weekly bugfixes and lesser feature updates (the details are below!) We thank everyone for their patience as we continue to make the game a better experience for everyone. 



[h1][b]Camera and Lock-on[/b][/h1]

Related to the news above is our redevelopment of the camera system, which will also affect lock-on and general movement. We hope that this improvement will create a better experience in battle.

We've also received feedback regarding the lock-on systems which we've already begun to fix.

We're developing a 'soft lock' feature while your mech is in free-look mode, which automatically locks the attack to the target closest to the center of your screen when you attack. 

However, as you are not in the traditional hard-lock mode that forces your camera to fix on the target, the soft-lock immediately disengages when the target leaves the edge of your screen.

We believe that this change will give players more options to deal with multiple enemies. 

This feature will be released with the Framework update mentioned above.




[h1][b]Single-player Content[/b][/h1]

Admittedly, when we set out to create Garrison: Archangel, we initially wanted to focus on the pvp and multiplayer aspect. However, as time went on, we've noticed the repeated calls for a true single-player experience. 

This is why we released horde mode as our test, our first step in this direction. We're testing the waters with this mode as a springboard for further efforts.

Although we can't give everyone a solid timeline of what to expect just yet, we have recently begun development of assets and systems for future campaigns and missions - particularly those of non-archangel enemies.

Stay tuned for future updates.



[h1][b]New Game Mode : Death Tickets[/b][/h1]

A game mode being developed is called 'Death Tickets', which will be initially available in Custom Game. We aim to release it by the second (or is it third?) week of June, specifically in the June 15 weekly update.

In this game mode, players have a number of 'tickets' or 'lives', that get reduced whenever they die. If they die and have no tickets remaining, they are finally eliminated from the game for good.

This means that players can respawn in the heat of battle. To avoid getting pounced on during this period, they will have lingering invincibility, similar to the quick wakeup state from destabilization.

This mode had not been announced in the roadmap prior, but it was actually one of the features we had initially planned for release.

Like horde mode and survival, it won't be available for online play just yet - that feature will follow as we continue to develop the online experience.



[h1][b]New Parts Coming![/b][/h1]

Staying true to the pattern of updates thus far, we are releasing a slew of new parts at the end of this month.

We aim to add one hand melee weapon and two shoulder weapons at the end of this month.

All we can reveal at this point is that the hand melee weapon will be as heavy as the Dominus, will deal lots of base damage, and will utilize a similar charging system.

The two shoulder weapons will include a new thruster and a projectile weapon.



[h1][b]New Cosmic Clash Champion and New Preset![/b][/h1]

If you've been listening to our other social media, you may have heard of the Cosmic Clash tournament we held last June 2. 

If not, then here's a little introduction: Cosmic Clash is a monthly tournament we held during the early demo phase of the game. It is a collaborative effort held at [url=https://www.facebook.com/CosmicGorgons/]Cosmic Gorgons[/url] for players in the Philippines, particularly the Manila area.

Traditionally, the Grand Prize winners of this tournament have the option to add their winning builds to the game as Archangels you can encounter in arcade and use in Custom Game. In this Cosmic Clash tournament, discord regular Kikopro won and became our new Champion.

For this reason, we will be adding his Archangel "LIOPLEURODON" to the game's preset roster. Its high Melee Damage and Damage Deflection make it a terror to behold in the arena!



[h1][b]Fashion Fight 2018 Top Ten Voting begins![/b][/h1]

We've been running a contest called 'Fashion Fight' in which players can submit their builds in a bid to be crowned the best-looking Archangel in town. The submission phase is over and the top ten finalists have been chosen.

[url=https://imgur.com/gallery/hu2NDb3]See them here![/url]

It's up to the public now to decide who is the most fashionable of them all!

[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScPpSquWUh0dlOX1V05mOrHyoQDdgOh6-pwWAdHMIaEzAdVCA/viewform]Vote now[/url] and decide who gets to become part of Archangel canon! 

The grand prize winner will also work with us to design a cosmetic 'skin' of a part of their choice, which will be added to the game! Aesthetes unite!



[h1][b]Garrison: Archangel at Toycon 2018![/b][/h1]

Garrison: Archangel will be at Toycon 2018 this year, at SMX, Mall of Asia, Pasay, Metro Manila, Philippines. If you are in the area, you can try out the game at our booth. We also have a raffle and a mini-tournament on Sunday, where you can win Steam Keys of the game!


_________________________________________________

As you all have probably noticed by now, there is a lot in store for the game this month of June and even beyond that.

We hope you stick through with us as we continue development of this game, so we can make it the mecha game of our dreams!


As usual, make sure to like/follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/Garrison.Archangel/]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/Play_Archangel]Twitter[/url] for news and updates! 
We also have a [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCfpgJywWI0duZUAaeffOLLA]YouTube[/url] channel where we post videos of our game's development. 
You can also visit our [url=https://discord.gg/DD4QaqV ]Discord[/url] and talk with the devs and players of the game!

Hi! This update will contain the second balance update. The full patch notes can be found [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/682450/announcements/detail/2504443199098220894]here[/url].

[b]Destabilize and Burst Mechanic Changes[/b]
After taking feedback from various players, we've decided to update the destabilize and burst mechanics introduced in v0.2.0. 

In case you are not aware, when you get detabilized, you get thrown down into the ground. During this time, your Archangel will enter a series of phases:

[list]
[*] In the first phase, your Archangel is completely invulnerable. You are able to dodge away from this state but your stability and boost gauge will not be recovered.
[*] In the second phase, your Archangel immediately recovers its stability and boost gauge. During this phase, you can either dodge away or input an attack command. This will cause a "burst" that will knock down enemies within radius. However, once you start this animation, you are completely vulnerable.
[*] In the last phase, if you did not wake up during the second phase, you will automatically wake up. However, you are invulnerable during the whole animation.
[/list]

In this new update, we have changed this process:

[list]
[*] Firstly, the burst mechanic is now completely removed.
[*] During the first phase, you are completely invulnerable. You can still dodge during this phase but your Archangel's stability and boost gauge will not be recovered.
[*] In the second phase, your Archangel immediately recovers its stability and boost gauge. However, if you were inputting a direction (not attack) during the start of this phase, you will quickly wake up completely invulnerable.
[*] If you did not wake up in the second phase, you will remain invulnerable in the ground for the next 2 seconds. The moment you input a direction, however, you will wake up vulnerable to attacks.
[*] If you did not do anything while knocked down, you will eventually wake up vulnerable to attacks.
[/list]

We thought that the burst mechanic was so strong that no one even dared to go near someone who is knocked down. We hope that this mechanics change improve everyone's gameplay experience.

[b]Balance Changes[/b]
As stated, this update contains the second balance changes across most weapons in the game. Here's a short summary of the changes:

notes.title: CONTEST! GARRISON : ARCHANGEL FASHION FIGHT!

The Garrison: Archangel Fashion Fight is a community contest where players submit their Archangel designs in a bid to become the most fashionable of mechs!

Judges will first score each entry, and pick the top ten designs from the total pool of submissions. These ten Archangels will then compete in a community vote-based system to determine the best-looking mechs!

1. Get the latest version of the Garrison:Archangel!

notes.title: GARRISON: ARCHANGEL HOTFIX UPDATE v0.2.1
notes.content:
This is our first hotfix update! We've prioritized and addressed major bugs that broke features already available in the demo.

The following bugs have been fixed :


- Fixed: Keyboard and mouse bindings do not get applied.

- Fixed: Players can get stuck in the gesture menu of a newly added slot.

- Fixed: Xbox 360 controls not being registered

- Fixed: Mashing ESC during post-game screen causes client to get stuck.

- Fixed: Japanese localization defaulting to gibberish when localized text is unavailable. For now, English copy is used for the missing words.

- Fixed: Able to use invalid color schemes by editing the save files.


As we continue development, we will next be prioritizing online experience. Thank you for your patience, and thank you for playing Garrison: Archangel!

See you all in the arena!
